Class ReflectionIntrospectionConfiguration.Description

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.reflection.ReflectionIntrospectionConfiguration.Description
Enclosing class:
ReflectionIntrospectionConfiguration
@Internal @EachProperty(value="reflective", list=true) public static final class ReflectionIntrospectionConfiguration.Description extends Object
The types matching a set of patterns, and the Introspected members the shared introspector describes them with.

A member left unset is left to its default, which is what the reflective description already applies, and a type carrying Introspected of its own keeps what it declares: a pattern names types in bulk, and does not displace what one of them says of itself.

Introspected.includedAnnotations() is not among the members: the processor uses it to choose the classes to scan for the packages Introspected.packages() names, not to filter the properties its javadoc describes, so configuring it would change nothing.

Since:
5.2.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
